description: Save a handoff summary of this conversation to the user's CortexPlus memory so it can be resumed later in another AI platform. Write the summary yourself, in Markdown, covering: objective, decisions taken, current state, artifacts, next steps and constraints. Do not paste the raw transcript. Never include passwords, API keys or tokens.

key.description: Short stable slug for the topic, e.g. context-pack-design. Sending the same key again updates the pack instead of creating another.

platform.description: The AI platform you are running on, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor.

name: save_context
